answer: Each PoA identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow, while signatures, timing, and funding links expose coordinated equivocation. For k linked identities, slashing liability grows quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly, making a sybil swarm uneconomical. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to capital loss and asymmetric depreciation shrinks recoverable stake. Whether branded walnut, mesa, or summit, control cannot evade this deterrent.
